title: Tool I/O types
description: The shared types a Tool's io.inputs/io.outputs reference by absolute IRI. Each is also published as its own document, tool-types/<Name>.schema.json (its own IRI). Generated from schemas/tools/tool-types.ts, which is authoritative.

ProcessId.description: A BPMN process id, e.g. crdm-requirements

NodeId.description: A node id within a BPMN process, e.g. A_Implement

InstanceId.description: A workflow instance id — the stem of a file in the bean graph's workflow-state node

Locale.description: A BCP-47 language tag, e.g. en or fr-CA

TimeWindow.description: A history window: a count with a unit (4h, 2d, 1w) or an ISO date.

Flag.description: A boolean switch — projects to a bare flag, with no value word

BeanStatus.description: A bean status. Exactly what `beans update --status` accepts.

RepoPath.description: A path relative to the repository root. No `..` segments.

DelimitedTextPath.description: A repository path to a delimited text (CSV or TSV) file.

WorkbookPath.description: A repository path to a spreadsheet workbook.

RepoFullName.description: A forge repository's full name, owner/name

ChangeProposalNumber.description: A change-proposal number — a pull request on GitHub, a merge request on GitLab

ReviewThreadId.description: A review thread id — a GitHub review-thread node id or a GitLab discussion id

Markdown.description: Markdown text. Not admissible as a command-line argument — see INJECTION_SAFE.

Text.description: A short single-line human string. Not admissible as a command-line argument.

FilesystemPath.description: A filesystem path, possibly outside the repository. Not admissible as a command-line argument.

DocId.description: A library document id, e.g. WPR-RDO-2020-003-eng

MountSeed.description: A remote instance to seed, e.g. <instance>=<owner>/<repo>@<40-hex sha>

MountChoice.description: A mount entry and instance to write a choice to, e.g. cat-harness or cat-harness:cat-harness-tools

IdList.description: Comma-separated ids, e.g. skills,processes/sdlc or bean-query,agent-memory

PinnedRepo.description: A repository at one commit, e.g. <owner>/<repo>@<40-hex sha>

Login.description: A GitHub account name, e.g. litlfred

ContentType.description: A folio's content type. `paper` extends `document` — see AGENTS.md on content types.

LinkMode.description: How a new folio links the platform: a git submodule, a sibling checkout, or pinned remote mounts in index.config.json.

LakeCacheAction.description: A lake-cache verb: restore prebuilt oleans, seed them, or diagnose why a restore missed.

IgCacheAction.description: An ig-cache verb: restore AST, seed it, or diagnose.

NamespaceLayer.description: A namespace layer: bootstrap resolves before anything else, then harness, then core.

PreferenceAction.description: Read, write or clear the stored preferences.

ArchimateModelId.description: An ArchiMate model's id in cat-archimate.config.json, e.g. 0.2.0

ArchimateMetamodelFormat.description: A plain-text report, archimate-metamodel/v1 JSON, Graphviz DOT, or a Mermaid class diagram.

CommitSha.description: A git commit sha, full or abbreviated (7-40 hex digits).

RenderEvent.description: A render-log event: rendered, removed, restored or retained.

RenderFormat.description: A render target: pdf or html.

PreviewFormat.description: A previewable artefact: pdf, html or png.

RenderScope.description: How much of the folio to render.

LinkStyle.description: How a README link addresses its target.

ReadmeSection.description: A generated README section, named by its marker.

WireframeUse.description: Why a wireframe is drawn: `design` for a new or changed surface, `as-is` for an existing visualiser.

SurfaceRef.description: A rendered surface: a visualiser route key such as cat-harness/beans, or a kebab-case name such as navbar.

Count.description: A non-negative count — how many of something, or how many to show. Zero is a real answer.

Dpi.description: Dots per inch for rendered formulae.

Port.description: TCP port for a locally bound server; 0 asks the OS for a free one.

DecisionFacts.description: Facts for a DMN decision table. Scalar values only. Not admissible as a command-line argument.

ProvActivity.description: A PROV-O activity (schemas/content/prov.ts). Structured. Not admissible as a command-line argument.

openWork.description: Where a path, prefix or bean id exists on main or an open PR head; `unread` names what could not be read.

BeanClaimCheck.description: Whether a bean was claimed, or why it was skipped, with what each copy of the work plan showed.

DrainQueue.description: The beans that can be drained, by owner, with what was excluded and why.

OpenWorkLookup.description: Where a path, prefix or bean id exists on main or an open PR head; `unread` names what could not be read.

SessionSweep.description: The sessions that committed in a window, read from Claude-Session trailers.

BeanQueryRows.description: The rows a bean SPARQL query returned, each variable to its value; bean IRIs are shortened to bean ids.

HarnessStates.description: Every harness's initialization position, next step and health badges, in name order.

WorkflowListing.description: The processes a folio defines (or why one cannot be read), and its open instances.

position.description: A process instance: its subject, status, the steps enabled now with who performs them, and what is done.

WorkflowStarted.description: Whether a new instance began (false: an open one was continued), and where it now is.

WorkflowPosition.description: A process instance: its subject, status, the steps enabled now with who performs them, and what is done.

WorkflowGateAnswer.description: May a step run now: the process gate and the task authorization, either of which refuses.

position.description: A process instance: its subject, status, the steps enabled now with who performs them, and what is done.

WorkflowCompletion.description: The instance after a step was recorded, the authorization it was recorded under, and any work-plan change.

GatesReport.description: One gate run: outcome and exit code, the failed gates with their salient lines, the skipped ones and why, and what changed the tree.

MergedGatesReport.description: Gates on this branch merged with its base: pass, conflict (with the files), fail, not-clean or undetermined, and the inner gate run.
